name: gap_fade_reversion_v103
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps up or down >0.3% overnight, option market makers who sold gamma are immediately delta-offside and begin hedging within the first 30 seconds — selling into gap-ups and buying into gap-downs. Simultaneously, VWAP/TWAP algorithms with previous-close benchmarks aggressively fade the opening price, creating a 20-50 spot point reversion impulse in the first 60-90 seconds of the session. At 5-second resolution, we detect the moment this institutional fade starts (price reversing back toward prev close within the first 5 bars of the day) and enter before the bulk of the impulse occurs, targeting the first leg of gap closure.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Measures the overnight gap magnitude. Uses the day's first bar open vs the previous day's last close. No bar-period scaling needed — this is a day-level reference, not a rolling window. Gap threshold 0.3% = ~60 NIFTY pts is calibrated to filter behavioral (fade-able) gaps from structural (news-driven) gaps.

indicators.name: fade_momentum
indicators.formula: close[i] vs close[i-3] direction: reverting toward prev_close from day_open
indicators.purpose: 3-bar (15-second) confirmation that price is actively moving away from day_open back toward prev_close. Chosen because institutional hedging starts within the first 5-10 seconds but needs 2-3 bars to show a clean directional print. Shorter than 1-bar (too noisy) but not so long (>6 bars) that we miss the entry window.

indicators.name: vol_ma_12
indicators.purpose: 60-second rolling volume baseline. Gap fade requires institutional participation — if volume in the current bar is not meaningfully above the 60-second average, the fade is likely retail noise rather than algo flow. 12 bars (60s) gives a meaningful early-session baseline without requiring the full pre-open history.

conditions: close > day_open (price has started bouncing above today's open)
close > close[i-3] (positive 15-second momentum confirming fade direction)
volume > 1.2 * vol_ma_12 (above-average volume confirming institutional participation)
time_minutes in [555, 575) — only in first 20 min of session
vix between 10 and 25 (skip panic gaps that aren't behavioral)
close < day_open (price has started fading below today's open)
close < close[i-3] (negative 15-second momentum confirming fade direction)
volume > 1.2 * vol_ma_12 (above-average volume confirming institutional participation)
time_minutes in [555, 575) — only in first 20 min of session

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If NIFTY has gapped up 60+ pts but after our entry the gap-up deepens a further 8 spot pts, the institutional fade thesis has failed and we must exit. This is tighter than the typical 30s NIFTY range (2-5 pts) because the gap-fade setup is high-conviction — if price extends rather than reverting immediately after entry, it's a 'gap-and-go' not a 'gap-fade'.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot pts). The first leg of NIFTY gap reversion in the opening minute covers 20-40 spot pts; 14 spot pts is the conservative 40th percentile of this distribution. With a 4-pt stop and 7-pt target (1:1.75 R:R), we need only 37% win rate to break even — the behavioral gap-fade on NIFTY historically runs 55-65% hit rate on this time horizon.

filters.vix_filter: vix between 10-25 — below 10 means no overnight fear so gap is microstructural; above 25 means macro event and gap won't fade behaviorally
filters.time_filter: 09:15-09:35 IST only — gap fade is strictly an opening phenomenon; after 20 min the gap has either closed or proved structural
filters.trend_filter: none — gap fade is mean-reverting, direction is determined by gap direction not trend
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium-low — behavioral/structural: VWAP benchmarking is institutionally mandated and not likely to disappear

adaptation_notes: Original trades nifty200 equities on 5-min bars, holding 25-75 minutes for full gap closure to prev_close. Conversion compresses to 5-second NIFTY index bars targeting only the FIRST IMPULSE of gap reversion (15-60 seconds). Key changes: (1) Target compressed from full gap fill (~200 pts) to first-leg reversion (~14 pts = 7 option pts). (2) Time window shrunk to first 20 min only — after that, gap has resolved or proved structural. (3) Added 15-second fade confirmation (3-bar momentum) absent in original because 5-min bars already showed direction; at 5s we need early confirmation. (4) VIX upper limit 25 to filter macro-driven gaps that won't fade. (5) Volume confirmation retained from original but adapted to 60-second rolling baseline instead of daily SMA.
weaknesses: Gap-and-go days (NIFTY gaps up AND continues up) will consistently hit stops — budget for 40%+ loss days
Pre-market futures data not available; gap detected at first 5s bar open which may miss the very first tick
Only 1-3 trades per day maximum; strategy is high-alpha but low-frequency
Budget/RBI/election gaps are structural, not behavioral — VIX filter may not catch all such events
